how_this_works: Everything you see around Ember that isn't a building. Edit it in builder mode (World tab) or by hand.
roof: the platform Ember lives on. size is its width (the roof spans -size/2 to size/2).
tower: the skyscraper under the roof. city: the towers all around (change seed for a different city).
signs and props: free-standing neon signs and decorations. pos is [x, height, z]; they can float.
sky: background, fog, light, glow (bloom) and exposure (overall brightness).
